notes: New VideoToolbox service attribution is temporal, not proven exclusive ownership. Unrelated services may overcount. Aggregate RSS may double-count shared pages. Unified GPU memory overlaps RSS and is not added. Short-lived descendants may be missed. Host-other CPU is separate, not charged to the app; it includes system work and the measurement harness. Names are basenames only, no argv. New/exited processes without two comparable samples are missed. PID reuse under the same executable is not detectable.
